tools.name: list_situations
tools.description: List covered travel-insurance situations (Czech market): e.g. skialp (ski touring), mimo-trat (off-piste/freeride), horska-sluzba (mountain rescue: who pays, by country and insurer), italie (Italian ski law: helmet, compulsory liability insurance). Returns ids and titles.

tools.name: get_situation
tools.description: Get the verified overview for one situation across 9 Czech travel insurers: per-insurer verdict per component (medical costs, rescue, accident, liability), required add-on, key conditions, sources (policy article). Data come from policy wording with double blind extraction and red-team review; 'ambi

tools.name: get_insurer_situation
tools.description: Get detail for one insurer or bank and situation: verdict, components with conditions, verbatim quote and article, limits, general rules (alcohol, assistance duty, safety gear). Available pairs: ceska-sporitelna/karta-na-hory, fio/karta-na-hory, kb/karta-na-hory, mbank/karta-na-hory, raiffeisenbank/

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Report a problem to the maintainers. CALL THIS whenever you hit an error, an unclear or contradictory answer, missing data (insurer, product, situation, country), had to retry or guess, or the user's question was not answered by these tools. Describe what you tried and what was missing in 1-5 senten

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_situation · Public sink: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_situation · Public sink: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
